[Question 9(c)]  
8. At 1534 hours, in view of the rapid fire spread at Wang Cheong House and Wang Tai House, and the fire development at Wang Shing House, Wang Kin House and Wang Sun House, I decided that additional Fire Services resources were required for firefighting, search and rescue operations, so I upgraded the fire incident to No.4 Alarm. At the same time, I tasked ADO CHEUNG to continue firefighting operations at Wang Kin House and Wang Sun House; ADO CHOW Tsz-ho to assist me in handling Mayday rescue operation; SStnO HUI to tackle fire at Wang Shing House, Wang Cheong House and Wang Tai House and to gain clearer access for the ERTs into Wang Cheong House.

[Question 9(a) continued]  
9. At about 1545 hours, a massive collapse of ignited scaffolding sent a torrent of burning bamboo sticks and debris cascading onto the open ground between Wang Cheong House and Wang Tai House. Recognising the escalating hazard, I made an immediate call to pull back all crew members from the impact zone. In about 30 seconds, crew members resumed firefighting operations with 3 jets in use at the open ground between Wang Cheong House and Wang Tai House.

[Question 7(b) continued]  
10. At about 1555 hours, whilst I was conducting assessment of hazards at the roundabout inside Wang Fuk Court near northeast façade of Wang Tai House, I noted that several crew members endeavoured to clear out debris at the open ground in front of the front entrance at the east side of Wang Tai House. I immediately proceeded to their location and noted SFn HO, unconscious, lying on a quantity of burning bamboo sticks and debris.
